scope: production full-image RGBA8_UNORM multisample import/readback, pending renderer/game integration
upload: fullscreen fragment SSBO reads; one native sample-mask pipeline per selected sample; color attachment LOAD/STORE; no sampleRateShading
readback: compute samplerless texture2DMSArray fetch; packUnorm4x8 to SSBO; no resolve/averaging
synchronization: explicit input/output/image access states, all-layer transitions, distinct descriptors retained until caller fence

native_contract.scope: deterministic Vulkan API adapter; not real GPU

shaders.independent_validation: GLSL glslangValidator -V --target-env vulkan1.1 and spirv-val; regenerated output matches embedded header

limitations: not connected to production guest renderer by this patch
single-sample targets retain existing copy path
caller owns buffer/image/transfer lifetime through GPU completion
resource cache, guest shader descriptors, resolves, and depth import/export remain separate work
